title: Doorbell counted thirteen kids. I gave candy to twelve 🎃
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark, moody, low key lighting, 35mm film grain, desaturated, realistic, suburban American home at night, no text, no watermark
hook_text: On Halloween, my doorbell camera counted thirteen trick-or-treaters. I gave candy to twelve.

scenes.narration: On Halloween, my doorbell camera counted thirteen trick-or-treaters. I gave candy to twelve.

shots.prompt: front porch at night with a glowing jack-o-lantern and a bowl of candy, doorbell camera angle, empty steps in the dark, no person visible

scenes.narration: I always count them. Witches. A ghost. Two tiny astronauts. Twelve kids. Twelve thank-yous.

shots.prompt: suburban front steps at night with paper decorations, orange porch light, small silhouettes in costumes far away, no faces

scenes.narration: At ten, I checked the video. Thirteen figures climbed my steps. Twelve took candy. The last one stood at the back. Arms at its sides. Not moving.

shots.prompt: doorbell camera fisheye view of a porch at night, a group of small figures and one tall dark figure standing very still at the back, no faces visible

scenes.narration: I zoomed in. It wore a gray coat. My gray coat. The same torn pocket. The same keys hanging from the belt.

shots.prompt: grainy zoomed security camera frame of a gray coat with a torn pocket, hanging keys, no head visible, blurred

scenes.narration: It never looked at the kids. It never looked at the bowl. It looked straight into the camera, the whole time, like it knew I would watch.

shots.prompt: grainy security camera frame, a dark figure in the back of a porch facing the lens, face hidden in shadow, orange glow from a pumpkin

scenes.narration: Then my phone buzzed. My neighbor texted me. I live alone.

shots.prompt: dark living room, phone lighting up a couch cushion in the dark, no person visible

overlays.text: Who is standing on your porch?

scenes.narration: The doorbell chimed. Once. I checked the screen. The porch was empty. The chime came from inside my house.

shots.prompt: phone screen showing an empty porch at night in black and white, hallway behind it dark, no person visible

scenes.narration: I did not move. Behind me, a floorboard creaked. Slowly. One step at a time. Candy wrappers crinkled in a pocket I know by heart.

shots.prompt: dark living room seen from the couch, hallway doorway in the background with a thin line of orange light, no person visible

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do I turn around, or keep staring at the door?

overlays.text: TURN AROUND  or  STARE AT THE DOOR
